exposure: Size for gestational age (large for gestational age, small for gestational age)
cohort: 1,086,378 children born in Sweden from 2001 to 2012
finding: Cesarean delivery was associated with an increased risk of food allergy, while very preterm birth was associated with a decreased risk.
mod_finding: Cesarean delivery was associated with an increased risk of food allergy (HR 1.21, 95% CI 1.18-1.25).
